subject: Triforce symbol
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the Triforce symbol lowers the water level.

evidence.quote:
Turn right until you find a Triforce symbol on the ground. Stand on 
it and play Zelda's Lullaby to lower the water level.

subject: small chest
text: A small chest in the drained pool area contains Bombs.

evidence.quote:
Head back to the section 
of the room where you first entered, and the pool of water will be drained. 
Head down, open the small chest for some BOMBS, and head through the
crawlspace, kill the Skulltula, climb the wall and enter the door to face a 
sub-boss.

subject: large chest
text: Defeating the Dead Hand sub-boss by slashing its reachable head causes a large chest with the Lens of Truth to appear.

evidence.quote:
You have to slash its 
head when it's reachable. Keep doing this and it will lower again. Get caught 
in a hand again to lure it back up, and repeat this process until it's dead, 
and a large chest will appear. Open it to get the LENS OF TRUTH.

subject: small chest
text: A small chest revealed behind the large chest with the Lens of Truth contains a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Use this to reveal a small chest behind the large one. This contains a 
HUGE RUPEE.

subject: small chest
text: Bombing the brown pile of dirt on the second basement floor reveals a hole leading to a small chest with Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
Facing forward from the first fake wall, bomb the brown pile 
of dirt to the left to reveal a hole. Fall down it and open the small chest 
for some BOMBCHUS.

subject: small chest
text: A small chest reached through the first left off the west hallway contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head down the west hallway, and head 
through the first left. Drop down and open the small chest for a RECOVERY 
HEART.

subject: coffin
text: Lighting each unlit torch with a Deku Stick opens adjacent coffins, one of which contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Alright, now use a Deku Stick (haven't used one of those in a 
while, eh?) to light all the unlit torches. Each torch opens the coffin next 
to it, so make sure to put away the stick after lighting each torch so you 
don't waste one. Pretty much all the coffins have enemies inside, but one of 
them has a SMALL KEY.

subject: small chest
text: A small chest located through an opening in the west hall contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Look left and you'll see a smaller opening in the west 
hall. Head inside and open the small chest for another SMALL KEY.

subject: small chest
text: A small chest inside the right cell contains Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote:
Head into the right cell, kill the Skulltula, and open 
the small chest for some DEKU NUTS.

subject: treasure chest
text: A treasure chest hidden behind a fake wall to the east contains another Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Head east through the fake wall, turn 
right, and use the Lens of Truth to see another fake wall with a treasure chest 
inside. Open it to get another SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found across a hidden path beyond the unlocked east door in Bottom of the Well.

evidence.quote:
unlock the east door. Kill the bats, use the 
Lens of Truth to uncover a hidden path. Use it to cross the hole, and kill the 
Gold Skulltula at the end. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 061 out of 100)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found behind the unlocked west door in a room with a Deku Baba and possessed pots.

evidence.quote:
unlock the west door this time. Another Gold Skulltula is here. 
Kill the Deku Baba first, and be careful of the pots. They're possessed and 
will fly towards you. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 062 out of 100)

subject: small chest
text: The small chest on the other side of the room with hidden pits contains a Blue Rupee or a replacement Deku Shield.

evidence.quote:
There's
large hidden holes in this room, which is why you need the Lens on. The small
chest at the other side contains a Blue Rupee. (It has a Deku Shield if you
lost yours.)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A room guarded by a Like Like contains a chest with a Blue Rupee and a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Like 
Like quickly before it swallows you. If it does, it may likely take your 
Hylian Shield. If it does, quickly kill it so you can get it back. Open the 
chest for another Blue Rupee, and kill the last Gold Skulltula in this area. 
(GOLD SKULLTULAS: 063 out of 100)

subject: small chest
text: Bombing a brown pile of dirt on the left at the end of the west hall uncovers a small chest containing Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote:
Now, head through the west hall, and look 
left at the end. Use the Lens of Truth so you won't fall down the hole, and 
bomb the brown pile of dirt to uncover the last small chest. Open it to get 
some DEKU NUTS.

subject: Song of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time while standing on the edge of the lava room as Young Link removes the block in front.

evidence.quote:
You'll find a lava room. Stand on the edge and play the Song of 
Time to get rid of the block in front of you. Now exit the city. That was 
short, eh? Well, it had to be done while you are Young Link so....

subject: frogs
text: Playing the Song of Storms while standing on the end of the log for the frogs rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Once 
you are on the log's end and have the Ocarina out, play the Song of Storms.  
They will be so pleased with the song that they will give you a Piece of Heart 
for your trouble. Wow! (HEART PIECES: 27 out of 36)

subject: frogs minigame
text: Playing the fixed note sequence A, left C, right C, down C, left C, right C, down C, A, down C, A, down C, right C, left C, A quickly for the frogs awards another Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
A, left C, right C, down C, left C, right C, down C, A, down C, A, down C,
right C, left C, A

Follow these very quickly and the frogs will be so pleased that they're full, 
so they give you yet another Piece of Heart. (HEART PIECES: 28 out of 36)

subject: Secret Cave
text: Playing the Song of Storms while standing on the rock with the Zora near the entrance opens a Secret Cave with a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote:
You see the Zora on 
the rock near the entrance? Stand on the rock he's on and play the Song of 
Storms to open a Secret Cave. Here's a Fairy Fountain.

subject: Treasure Box Game Shop
text: Paying 10 Rupees to play the Treasure Box Game at night and using the Lens of Truth to pick the chests with keys awards a Piece of Heart at the end.

evidence.quote:
This is the Treasure Box Game 
Shop. Pay 10 Rupees to play, and head through the door. Now, your job is to 
find the small key that's in one of the two chests and use the key to continue. 
To make this easy, and possible, use the Lens of Truth to find the key. You 
aren't penalized for using it. Do this until you reach the end. Open the 
chest for a Piece of Heart. (HEART PIECES: 29 out of 36)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found along one of the sides of the ruined outer gate of Ganon's Castle.

evidence.quote:
Head to the ruined outer gate, and look around one of the sides 
of it to find a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 064 out of 100)

subject: Broken Goron's Sword
text: Giving the Poacher's Saw to the man across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley yields the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Give the Poacher's Saw that you should have and he'll 
give you a BROKEN GORON'S SWORD, which as you can tell is absolutely useless as 
of now.

subject: Secret Cave
text: Playing the Song of Storms behind the man's tent opens a Secret Cave with two Business Scrubs selling potions.

evidence.quote:
Before leaving, play the Song of Storms behind the guy's tent to open 
a Secret Cave. Remember what the Secret Cave at the beginning of Zora's River 
had? Well, this is exactly the same. (Two Business Scrubs selling potions at 
an equal price.)

subject: Poe shop
text: Selling 10 Big Poe souls to the buyer in the former guardshack awards 100 points per soul and grants an Empty Bottle upon reaching 1000 points.

evidence.quote:
This creepy 
guy inside buys Poe souls. He gives you a card (which isn't an item, oddly)
and for every Big Poe soul you sell him, he'll give you 100 points on your
card. When you get 1000 points, (and there are 10 Big Poes..how lucky) he
gives you an Empty Bottle as a prize.

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poes must be defeated with the Fairy Bow while riding Epona, and their souls collected in Empty Bottles on foot.

evidence.quote:
For all Big Poes, you must be on Epona, and thus 
you have to use the Fairy Bow to kill them. To collect the Big Poe soul, get 
off Epona and walk toward the soul. The game will ask you if you want to keep 
it in one of your Empty Bottles.

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poe #1 appears directly ahead after riding forward a bit on Epona.

evidence.quote:
#1: Get on Epona, and go forward a bit. A Big Poe should appear in front of
 you.

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poes #2 and #3 hide where the two upper paths join on the Y-shaped path near the stone walls.

evidence.quote:
#2 and #3: See the Y-shaped path on the mini-map? There are two Big Poes
 hiding at the point where the two upper paths join. If you can't find the
 second one, try looking around the nearby stone walls.

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poe #4 is found in the middle of the trees within the mini-forest.

evidence.quote:
#4: Head to the mini-forest here, and you'll encounter this one in the middle
 of the trees.

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poe #5 appears right after the bottom leg of the Y-shaped path ends when running through the nearby grass.

evidence.quote:
#5: There's another right after the bottom leg of the Y-shaped path ends. If
 it doesn't appear, run through the patch of grass nearby, and it should appear
 then.

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poes #6 and #7 hide along the path leading to Gerudo Valley, with one at the fork and the other by the tree at the path's end.

evidence.quote:
#6 and #7: There are two Big Poes hiding at the path leading to Gerudo Valley.
 They're basically one right after the other. One's at the fork, and the other
 is by the tree at the end of the path.

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poe #8 rests on the west side of the river within a grove of trees surrounded by water.

evidence.quote:
#8: Up ahead is a grove of trees surrounded by a river. On the west side of
 the river is where this Big Poe rests.

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poe #9 hides right by a tree located on the north side of Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote:
#9: On the north side of Lon Lon Ranch is a tree. This Big Poe is hiding right
by it.

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poe #10 appears near a lone tree by the river near Kakariko and can be caught by hugging the wall toward the water and passing to the right of the stone pillar.

evidence.quote:
#10: This is the final one that I list for a good reason. It's the hardest to
catch. After going over the tiny bridge leading to Kakariko, head toward the
lone tree on the right, close to the river. This Big Poe should appear..."I found the easiest way to catch the last Big Poe near the entrance to 
Kakariko was to hug the wall with Epona (the wall where the entrance to 
Kakariko is), and then head south toward the water (If the poe appears, just 
wait a few seconds after it disappears). Then turn around once you hit the 
water (back up a bit if need be). You should be facing the little stone pillar 
holding up the cliff. Pass to the RIGHT of it (not to the left, under the 
cliff), and the poe should appear, heading straight toward the tree that you 
bomb as a kid to get a Skulltula. This is probably the most time you'll have to 
shoot at the poe."
